description: Details required by Conditions 3 (Submission of details), 4 (Works to match retained fabric), 5 (Retention of fabric), 6 (Demolition - protection of interior), 7 (Partitions), 8 (Railings), 9 (No external paraphernalia), 10 (Recessed ceiling lights) of listed building consent LB/23/04217 (Renovation of building improving accessibility and fire strategy, and providing higher quality spaces. External works include: Signage, facade lighting, green balcony, external and internal lift and openings along Cromwell Mews. Internal alterations include: On lower ground floor: Activity/meeting spaces, WCs, lift and circulation space and maintenance store/archive room. On ground level: reception, learning cafe, internal lift, circulation space and WCs. On first floor level: Circulation space, internal lift and outdoor roof terrace. On second and third floor levels: Minor internal alterations)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
